name: Jira
description: Jira Cloud REST v3 native tools (9 methods, each is a named tool). Generic: jira_search / jira_get / jira_comment / jira_transition. Orchestrator: jira_create_task / jira_create_subtask / jira_submit_verdict / jira_abandon_task / jira_request_help. Reads ATST_TOKEN / JIRA_CLOUD_ID / JIRA_PROXY from env. See skills/jira/SKILL.md for per-tool guidance.
